CA.rationale: Content attribute (red) and a processing-origin (command_estimate) are both explicitly bound to the same candidate referent/time.

COD.rationale: Identified content attribute (red) plus explicit origin/organization metadata provide content, organization/access and a separate status distinction for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Processing-origin labels (history_estimate, command_estimate) are explicitly linked to the same identified contents' organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers with attributes (red/blue sets) are present for named referents.

D.rationale: Contents/attributes (red sets) are presented separately from origin/organization metadata for the same referents, showing an explicit content-versus-status distinction.

O.rationale: Explicit presentation/organization information is provided (grid axes statement and origin/represented_time metadata indicating how content is represented/emerges).
